description: Start (or resume) a claim on a tool's Atlas card for the signed-in account. Answers with three ways to prove the domain - a badge link on any page of the site, a meta tag on the homepage, or a DNS TXT record - each with the exact snippet. If the account's email is on the domain and verified, the claim is proved at once. Then call atlas_owner_verify. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.

domain.description: The tool's domain as the Atlas lists it, e.g. acme.ai

name: atlas_owner_claim
title: Claim a tool's Atlas card
